questions.question_text: Which is the correct abbreviated form of 3 kilometres 450 metres?

options.why: The kilometre and metre abbreviations were reversed.
The metre total was labelled as kilometres.
The hundreds digit in the metre part was omitted.

questions.solution_text: Write the larger kilometre part first and the remaining metres second: $3\text{ km }450\text{ m}$.
